brief.subject: Class A regional dry van driver

recipe.name: On the road, in figures
recipe.hook_formula: Lead with one of the brief's own figures as evidence rather than a promise (the pay, or the miles), and put a second on the second line (the home time, or the bonus), so the two read side by side. If the brief states only one figure, the second line is the plainest fact beside it. Never round, never add a figure.
recipe.image_prompt_template: Our truck driving on {road} through {setting}, {viewpoint}, {light}, {season}, no text, no logos, no lettering
